claim: In a 68-week trial, semaglutide led to an average weight loss of 14.9%.
answer: In a 68-week trial, semaglutide led to an average weight loss of 14.9%. Participants on placebo lost about 2.4% of body weight.
evidence: The mean change in body weight from baseline to week 68 was -14.9% in the semaglutide group as compared with -2.4% with placebo.
label: supported
